mentions.name: Starkeep
mentions.description: An open-source, fully serverless self-hosting system that lets you keep your own data and build your own apps running on your own devices and AWS account. Its common core provides file indexing, syncing, and access control, making apps easy to create and interoperable, with easy deployment and minimized running costs. MIT licensed.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Starkeep, an open-source serverless self-hosting system that lets you keep your own data and build your own apps that run on your devices and your own AWS account.
mentions.author: kolleraa
